body:
## [3.76.0] - 2026-09-10

### Features

- enhance closing report with closing control data and add tests
- add Phone previous transactions experience
- Enhance cart engine providers with improved state management and error handling
- Enforce final contribution to settle remaining amount in split sessions
- Enhance Phone POS functionality with improved diagnostics and error handling
- rebaseline Phone/F20 flows through split payments

### Bug Fixes

- correct stale Phone payment review recovery
- correct Phone split draft recovery and restore split UI

### Other Changes

- simplify product mutation test setup by removing unnecessary overrides
- Fix partial gift card and voucher scans
- Remove legacy Odoo POS vendor code
